projectTitle: 51Degrees Device Detection, IP Intelligence, Human Confidence, and Identifiers for Java
description: Maven artifacts com.51degrees:device-detection and com.51degrees:ip-intelligence. new DeviceDetectionPipelineBuilder().useOnPremise(dataFile, false) or .useCloud(resourceKey), then build(). In try-with-resources, data.addEvidence("header.user-agent", ua), data.process(), and data.get(DeviceData.class). IPIntelligencePipelineBuilder covers IP Intelligence. Web apps use the PipelineFilter servlet filter or Spring MVC FiftyOneInterceptor. DidClient in pipeline.did handles 51Did.
